annotations.title: Who can open a OneDrive file

description: action list (default): every sharing link and person with access to a OneDrive file or folder: link URL, view or edit, scope, expiry, password, whether it is inherited from a parent folder. action remove: revoke one (permissionId from the list); anyone relying on it loses access at once and the link cannot be restored, so WITHOUT confirm:true nothing is removed and you get what would go. An inherited permission is removed on the parent folder, and the owner's own access cannot be removed. Removal is verified by reading the list back. 0 credits. Needs OneDrive connected.
